english: Page for his patience and understanding and for the kindly encouragement he gave us when we went so unwillingly to school.
text: remember someone for something 把人和令人难忘的品质连接起来，这里的 for 不是“替他做事”。谈为什么感念一位老师，可以说耐心、体谅，也可以接具体给予的帮助；理由不一定要另起一个 because 句子。
